title: Why Plugging Wells Matters | CAPIT Environmental Impact
description: Discover why permanently retiring inactive oil and gas wells protects groundwater, eliminates methane leaks, and restores local ecosystems.
headline: Why Plugging Wells Matters
body: Every properly plugged well is a permanent investment in the land, communities, and future of the United States. One Well. One Token. One Permanent Record of Progress.

sections.heading: Public Safety & Land Restoration
sections.body: Inactive wellsites can leave aging equipment, open pits, and physical hazards. Proper plugging removes these risks and prepares the surface location for ecological recovery.

sections.heading: Groundwater & Air Protection
sections.body: Unsealed wellbores can serve as pathways for saline water or residual hydrocarbons to migrate into freshwater aquifers. Cementing the wellbore permanently seals downhole zones.
